messages.subject: ShinyApps preferred DB engine
parts:
Hello everyone,

I am going to develop a small ShinyApp (kind of protoype) based on retrieving data from Twitter and make some data mining & analysis.
I would like to know which is the preferred DB engine in order to deploy a Shiny application.

I have seen an example using SQLite: https://gist.github.com/trestletech/9793754

But maybe any other DB engine is more appropriate for the task I propose.

Thanks in advance.
